failure.observed: A combined read-only diff-check command ended with true after two git diff --check --no-index probes, masking their ordinary nonzero difference exits and preventing the aggregate exit code from representing every child command.
failure.policy_violation: No failed or nonzero child exit may be bypassed in this research workflow, even when git --no-index uses exit 1 only to report differences.

recovery.method: Discard that aggregate diff receipt, record this failure additively, and rerun direct JSON, whitespace, reference, focused, cumulative, Black and Ruff checks without exit masking.
